mentions.name: Lapyn
mentions.description: Lapyn is a product design platform where humans and AI agents can work on the same project. It provides a platform-independent system of record for a product that AI agents can interact with and use to generate code for any platform, storing not just design but also accessibility, translations, and behavior decisions in one place.
mentions.problem: With AI agents generating more and more code, there is no dedicated place where actual product decisions live beyond the design itself, such as accessibility, translations, and behavior.
mentions.source_excerpt:
It's a product design platform where humans and AI agents can work on the same project.

The main idea is to have a platform-independent system of record for your product that agents can interact with and use to generate code for any platform.
